title: Joins
description: Combining rows from two or more tables using various join types, including visualization and cross apply.
longDescription: This module teaches you how to combine data from multiple tables using SQL Server joins. You'll learn about INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN, CROSS JOIN, SELF JOIN, and CROSS APPLY with practical examples.
whatYouLearn: Understand the concept of joining tables
Use INNER JOIN to return matching rows
Use LEFT JOIN and RIGHT JOIN for outer joins
Use FULL OUTER JOIN to return all rows from both tables
Use CROSS JOIN for Cartesian products
Use SELF JOIN to query hierarchical data
Use CROSS APPLY to join with table-valued functions
